If you're new to /v/tweaks, hello! This is a short guide to posting at our subverse.

For posts relating to a tweak currently on Cydia...

  • Share a link directly to the tweak, don't do it via. a discussion post. Any information that you need to share can come in the form of a comment on the link post. Besides, it'll probably get you a bit of CCP that way.

  • Make sure the title follows a similar format to the one below:

[Free/Paid flair, if paid insert $PRICE] Cool Tweak Name - and a description of what it does. [Developer] [Repo]

  • I recommend that you give more information about the tweak in the comments of the link post. Give a clear description of what it does. Bonus points for any images or videos! Don't worry about your comment being buried, it will be stuck near the top.

For upcoming tweaks, or tweaks in development...

  • Provide a link to an image [album] or a video of the tweak if possible. Otherwise, provide a link to something that documents that indeed, this tweak is in production. For example, a tweet or a blog post from the developer.

  • Give any extra information you might need to give in the comments of the link post. Don't worry about your comment being buried, it will be stuck near the top.

For discussions, meta posts, or pretty much anything else...

  • You can use either a link or text post. For link posts, make sure the link you're posting is relevant first.

  • Ensure the title gives decent enough information about what it is the post is talking about. If you are using a text post, remember that you can always add more information.

Has anything been missed off, or do you have any questions? Feel free to message me (/u/Spalgra)!

To be clear, I'm not arguing that v/jailbait should be allowed. What I am trying to do is ask some hard questions of the Voat Community and administrators... When does censorship begin? Where does it end? We need to define these rules clearly and concisely.

To those who don't know what jailbait is, it was a subreddit on reddit.com that hosted images of underage girls that were fully clothed, but in sexually suggestive poses or otherwise wearing skimpy clothing. It existed on reddit for years and years until CNN did a story on it, after which it was banned within the week.

Do I agree with banning this subverse? Yes. But I do need to know the reasons behind censoring this kind of thing. Is it immoral, Yes. Is it a bad thing, Yes. Is it illegal? No. So why are we banning it? We need clearly defined reasons so that censorship does not eventually overstep it's bounds here on voat like it did on reddit.
